# Daily Dashboard V0.5.2

## Saved calendar Work mode

Choose **Work** beside Day and Week in the calendar (or use the view dropdown in narrow widgets). Work shows **Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM only**. It moves one week at a time, retains collision-safe meeting columns, and is saved across restarts. Day and Week continue to offer full-day access.

Calendar controls, focus states and current-day highlighting have been refined. Calendar time and Today now follow the selected calendar timezone.

## Weather refinement

- A fixed toolbar stays available while weather content scrolls.
- Clearer temperature and feels-like/range hierarchy, labelled UV/rain metrics, subdued forecast controls, and a consistent caution style.
- The five-day overview works in compact widgets and avoids repeating the individual-day metrics.
- Rain history has cleaner charts and concise source text. Radar attribution has its own footer, keeping it clear of the map.
- Loading and location-setup states remain dismissible and fit narrow widgets.

## Verification

The UI suite exercises six enabled widgets at all four documented sizes across 19 display/scaling configurations (456 base cases), plus Work selection/navigation/persistence and weather forecast, five-day, rainfall, radar, loading and setup states. Unit tests cover calendar date boundaries and strict work-hour endpoints; Rust tests cover the saved view preference.

Close Daily Dashboard before running the attached Windows installer over your existing version. The application identifier and settings location are unchanged. Physical Windows upgrade testing remains to be performed on your machine.
